title: Missile heading towards Medina destroyed, says Saudi Arabia; Houthis deny attack
summary_full: A missile targeting Saudi Arabia's Medina region was intercepted by the Saudi-led coalition according to their spokesperson. Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree refuted this claim, stating no operations were conducted towards Saudi territories. The ongoing conflict has resulted in a series of airstrikes from both the Houthis and coalition forces. Recent incidents include the destruction of a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh by the coalition.
